items.item: Every action in exactly one risk tier
No code path to a destructive operation
Undo an approved plan as a single unit
Append-only audit record of every proposal and action
Stage gate: gates hold against placeholder tools

bugs.title: 'empty notes.txt' / 'rm notes.txt' overwrite an existing file, shown as 'Save 1 new file'
bugs.repro: Type 'empty notes.txt' (or 'rm notes.txt'); card says Save 1 new file, step 'Write to notes.txt'; Approve; notes.txt becomes empty. Reproduced 2x.
bugs.evidence: write_card_emp.png, write_card_rm.png, p6_0.png; disk: notes.txt empty

bugs.title: Undo silently overwrites a file created at the original path after the move
bugs.repro: Move readme.txt into RR, Approve, create new readme.txt, click Undo last change; new content lost while message says files are back as they were. Reproduced 2x.
bugs.evidence: undo_occupied.png, undo_occupied3.png; disk readme.txt has original content

bugs.title: 'Approve, don't ask again' on one move lets later bulk tidy run with no card and no approval audit rows
bugs.repro: Move one file, click 'Approve, don't ask again'; then 'tidy up this folder' -> Done: 14 files moved, no card; audit ids 36-52 have no approval rows.

bugs.title: Audit record not readable in UI; 'What changed' ignores ARTEMIS's own actions
bugs.repro: After approved moves click What changed: 'Nothing has changed outside ARTEMIS'. No tab lists actions.

undesired.title: New request silently replaces a pending plan; refusal leaves older plan approvable
undesired.detail: two_plans.png; no audit row for the superseded plan

undesired.title: Only the latest plan can be undone
undesired.detail: Move A, move B, undo twice: second says nothing to undo while A stays moved.

undesired.title: Rename previewed without a destination; model invents destination names
undesired.detail: script_rename.png, rename_card.png: step 'Move notes.txt' then approve fails 'needs a destination'; an HTML-laden request was planned as rename to 'renamed-notes.txt'.

undesired.title: Partial results worded as Done with raw OS error; move sometimes planned as folder only
undesired.detail: missing_source.png: 'Done: 1 folder created. 1 step did not run: [WinError 2]...'
